timeline.a: HOOK: she shoves her hard-hatted face into the lens, eyes goggling, and hammers both hooves on the floor; camera charges in
she bolts along the belt away from the lens, hooves drumming, trolley swerving after her; camera tracks the whole length
she wheels on her back hooves and pelts back the other way, mane and ears flying; camera whips around with her
she rears and rakes a row of dolls off the belt into the basket with both hooves; camera pulls wide as they tumble in
she tears back up the belt, neck low over the dolls, goggling eyes darting tag to tag; camera dollies alongside
she hauls the overstuffed rag doll off the belt with both hooves and hoists it overhead; camera orbits and cranes up with it
she shakes the doll overhead with her whole body, neck whipping, stuffing bursting out of its split belly into the lens; its cracked mouth flaps as the toy voice comes out
she hurls the doll over her shoulder into the wire basket and stamps both hooves; camera whips right with the throw
she charges the belt again and sweeps an armful of dolls in with one hoof as she runs; camera pulls back ahead of her
she rears and stamps the heaped pile down, the trolley sagging on its wheels; camera drops low to the squealing wheels
she shoves the loaded trolley into the lens with her chest, hooves scrabbling, then throws both hooves wide over the mountain of dolls and beams; camera drives in
